app.title: Emergency Green Corridor
coach.title: Quick tips
coach.vehicle.1: Bind: enter your plate (or tap a demo plate) and press Bind.
coach.vehicle.2: Start: enter the incident ID, then press Start run.
coach.vehicle.3: Hold to speak: press and hold the big button to say what you see, then let go.
coach.cop.1: Go on duty: pick your junction and press the big green button.
coach.cop.2: Hear the alert: keep the screen on; the stage word and a spoken line arrive first.
coach.cop.3: ACK: tap the big ACK button once you have seen it.
coach.hospital.1: Select your hospital from the list at the top.
coach.hospital.2: Inbound: ambulances on their way appear with a countdown; tap one to open it.
coach.hospital.3: Handover: read the brief and tick off the checklist before arrival.
landing.hero_h: Clear the road before the siren arrives.
landing.hero_lede: Junction police get a spoken heads-up for every ambulance and fire engine on its way (police vehicles are supported), and the hospital gets the brief before arrival.
landing.saved_on: for the critical ambulance on the Bengaluru replay.
landing.problem: ambulances and fire engines lose minutes at red lights and queues, and junction police only find out when the siren is already there.
landing.fix: a green corridor. The moment a vehicle is on its way, each junction on its route gets a spoken heads-up so police can open the way, and the hospital gets the patient brief before arrival.
landing.step1: Open {link}, press Play (Replay opens at 50x). Watch the minutes-saved counter climb.
landing.step2: Open {link} and press Sample alert to hear what a junction cop hears.
landing.step3: Open {link} and open Last handover (appears after a live run).
landing.s_vehicle: Crew binds a plate, starts a run, speaks a triage note and confirms the tier.
landing.s_cop: Junction police go on duty, hear the alert (spoken in plain English; Kannada and Telugu switchable) and ACK.
landing.s_hospital: Countdown to arrival, live vitals, and a handover brief the team can tick off.
landing.s_control: Every run on the corridor, junction board, escalations and minutes-saved report cards.
landing.s_sim: Play the scripted scenario, or feed live GPS ticks, and watch the corridor open.
landing.s_dispatch: Issue the incident ID that a run starts from.
landing.g1: Voice and photo extraction: speech, typed text or a monitor photo into a fixed schema, with no tools.
landing.g2: ATMIST handover: the hospital brief and prep checklist, generated at ETA minus 5 minutes.
landing.g3: Alert phrasing: the short spoken line each junction cop hears.
landing.g4: Sequencing sentence: Gemini rewords a rule-built template into one line; the result is validated and the template is used if it fails.
landing.g5: Cop voice notes to rule actions: a spoken report from the junction fills a fixed schema, and plain rules act on it.
landing.g6: After-action report: a plain summary of each finished run, with the timeline built in code.
landing.g7: Hospital routing agent: built on Agent Development Kit, with four tools and a code guard that checks its choice before it is applied.
landing.limits: Traffic signals are simulated behind an adapter; the demo scenario uses hand-authored traffic spans; patients are synthetic; no user accounts; device-scoped tokens protect vehicle, cop and run actions; demo endpoints are rate-limited but reachable. Minutes saved is a simulated estimate, not a measurement.
